name: Adyen MCP Server
summary: Official alpha MCP server for Adyen Checkout and Management APIs: sessions, payment links, refunds, terminals and webhooks.
description: Runs locally via `npx -y @adyen/mcp` against Adyen's TEST or LIVE environment. Tools cover Checkout sessions and payment methods, payment links (create, status, expire), cancels and refunds, and Management API reads/writes for merchant accounts, terminals and terminal settings, webhooks, payment-method settings, users, API credentials and allowed origins. Use `--tools=` to expose only what you need; Adyen recommends a dedicated webservice user whose roles match the selected tools. Status: alpha.

agent_access.notes: Set ADYEN_API_KEY; npx -y @adyen/mcp --env=TEST (LIVE also needs --livePrefix). Adyen merchant account required; processing fees apply.
